The '''guerrilla research camp''' was a research camp used by [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] guerrilla military forces in [[Kaamos Territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was built atop the [[Resistance Ridge]].
